title: Nutty Thai Tamarind Ball Boat Noodles
description: A resinous and chewy Thai dish featuring tamarind balls, served as a solo dinner, broiled to perfection and dairy-free friendly, in a boat noodle form.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a blender, combine tamarind paste, palm sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, tamarind sauce, and chopped Thai basil, and toss to combine.
In a small pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the crushed peanuts, cooking until fragrant.
Add the tamarind balls to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
To assemble the dish, place the noodle mixture into a boat-shaped bowl, top with a tamarind ball, and drizzle with the peanut sauce.
Broil the dish for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
